verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm whose offering is legal counsel plus free founder resources such as glossaries and a document generator, so reading source code under an open license is not a fair axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm publishing source code under any license. The OpenLaw-based Automated Convertible Note is described only as a collaboration and document generator, not as openly licensed source, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
